title: 1986 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: A picture \(3\) feet across is hung in the center of a wall that is \(19\) feet wide. How many feet from the end of the wall is the nearest edge of the picture?

solutions.text:
The picture leaves \(19 - 3 = 16\) feet of wall, split equally into two gaps of \(8\) feet each. So the nearest edge of the picture is \(8\) feet from the end of the wall.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: The picture is centered, so the two gaps on the sides are equal
Subtract the picture width from the wall width, then split the remainder between the two sides
